metadata.title: Anthropic IPO: Claude Developer Chases $1.4T Valuation, What to Know<!-- --> - Barron's

content.text:
Anthropic Pushes Ahead With IPO. It’s Now Chasing a Much Lower $1.4T Valuation.
A wild few weeks for the artificial-intelligence trade hasn’t deterred Anthropic from pushing ahead with its trillion-dollar initial public offering that will establish it as the market’s AI bellwether.
